fields.id: proposed test-case slug: category prefix + title, same style as upstream
fields.gap: uncovered = SC had no mapping; related-only = only related/incidental mappings; thin = SC covered, but a distinct common failure (often a W3C Fxx) has no test
fields.fixture: single-page | single-page-script (needs fixture script) | linked-page | multi-page | media (needs licensed media asset) | flow (multi-step or timed)
fields.expected_detectability: automatable = rule engines can decide; partially = engines can flag or narrow, human confirms; manual = needs human judgement or interaction
fields.priority: high = level A/AA and common in practice; medium = A/AA less common or harder to build, or thin-coverage additions; low = AAA or rare

meta.note: HTML is written for candidates with status "implemented" (test case in src/test-cases/<test_case>.html). Candidates that need video or audio files have status "deferred" until openly licensed media is available (D-015).

candidates.title: Prerecorded video without audio description or media alternative
candidates.failure: A short local video whose key visual information (on-screen text, actions) is not in the soundtrack and has no audio description track or text alternative.
candidates.detectability_reason: Tools can detect a missing <track kind="descriptions"> but not whether visual information is missing from the audio.
candidates.deferred_reason: Needs an openly licensed local video file (D-015).

candidates.title: Live video stream without captions
candidates.failure: A live (or simulated live) video player with speech and no captions.
candidates.detectability_reason: Live status and caption presence cannot be inferred from markup.

candidates.title: Prerecorded video without sign language interpretation
candidates.failure: A video with speech and no sign-language interpretation.
candidates.detectability_reason: Requires judging the media content.

candidates.title: Video with no pauses for audio description and no extended description
candidates.failure: A video whose dialogue leaves no gaps for description and offers no extended (paused) audio description.
candidates.detectability_reason: Requires judging the media content.

candidates.title: Prerecorded video without full text alternative
candidates.failure: A video with speech and visual information and no transcript describing both.
candidates.detectability_reason: A tool cannot tell whether nearby text is a full alternative.

candidates.title: Live audio stream without text alternative
candidates.failure: A live (or simulated live) audio stream with no real-time text alternative.
candidates.detectability_reason: Live status cannot be inferred from markup.

candidates.title: Audio plays automatically with no way to stop it
candidates.failure: An <audio autoplay loop> element longer than 3 seconds with no controls and no pause or volume mechanism.
candidates.detectability_reason: autoplay without controls is detectable in markup; duration and audibility need checking.
candidates.deferred_reason: Needs an openly licensed local audio file (D-015).

candidates.title: Speech audio with loud background music
candidates.failure: A prerecorded speech recording with background sound less than 20 dB below the speech and no way to turn it off.
candidates.detectability_reason: Needs audio analysis.

candidates.title: Locally flashing animation above the general flash threshold
candidates.failure: A large self-hosted animation (e.g. CSS) that flashes red more than three times per second, replacing the external YouTube example.
candidates.detectability_reason: Flash analysis needs rendering over time (PEAT-type tools), not DOM rules.

candidates.title: Video-only content without alternative
candidates.failure: A silent prerecorded video (e.g. a how-to animation) with no text or audio alternative.
candidates.detectability_reason: Needs judging what the video shows.

candidates.title: SVG image without accessible name
candidates.failure: An informative inline <svg> (a chart or icon) with no <title>, aria-label or role="img" name.
candidates.detectability_reason: axe/HTMLCS can check svg[role=img] and inline SVG for a name.

candidates.title: Decorative image with non-empty alt text
candidates.failure: A purely decorative flourish with alt="decorative border image".
candidates.detectability_reason: Whether an image is decorative is a human judgement.

candidates.title: Icon font conveys meaning without text alternative
candidates.failure: An icon-font glyph (e.g. a phone icon before a number) with no text alternative and no visible text.
candidates.detectability_reason: Tools may flag empty elements with ::before content, but meaning needs judgement.

candidates.title: Image of text used for a heading
candidates.failure: A section heading rendered as a PNG of styled text where CSS could produce the same look.
candidates.detectability_reason: Tools can flag images with text-like alt; deciding it is avoidable text needs judgement.

candidates.title: Data table with role presentation
candidates.failure: A data table with headers given role="presentation", removing its table semantics.
candidates.detectability_reason: Role presentation on a table with th cells is detectable.

candidates.title: Headers attribute references wrong header ids
candidates.failure: A complex table whose td headers attributes point to the wrong th ids.
candidates.detectability_reason: Missing ids are detectable; pointing to the wrong existing header is not.

candidates.title: Layout table uses th and caption
candidates.failure: A layout table that marks its layout cells as th and has a caption.
candidates.detectability_reason: Tools can flag th/caption, but deciding the table is for layout needs judgement.

candidates.title: Table formatted with spaces in preformatted text
candidates.failure: Tabular data laid out with spaces inside a <pre> element instead of table markup.
candidates.detectability_reason: Recognising a whitespace table needs judgement.

candidates.title: Spaces used to spread out letters of a word
candidates.failure: A heading written as "W E L C O M E" with spaces between letters for visual effect.
candidates.detectability_reason: Single-letter sequences can be pattern-matched, with false positives.

candidates.title: ARIA list role without listitem children
candidates.failure: An element with role="list" whose children are plain divs without role="listitem".
candidates.detectability_reason: ARIA required-children rules detect this.

candidates.title: Instructions rely on shape
candidates.failure: Instructions say "Press the round button to continue" with no other identification of the control.
candidates.detectability_reason: Requires reading the instructions.

candidates.title: Graphical symbol alone conveys meaning
candidates.failure: A required-field indicator or status shown only by a symbol (e.g. a coloured tick) with no text explanation.
candidates.detectability_reason: Meaning of symbols needs judgement.

candidates.title: Content locked to portrait orientation
candidates.failure: CSS rotates the page 90 degrees in landscape (orientation media query) so content only displays in portrait.
candidates.detectability_reason: Needs rendering in both orientations; static CSS heuristics are possible.

candidates.title: Message asks user to rotate device
candidates.failure: In landscape the content is replaced by "Please rotate your device".
candidates.detectability_reason: Needs rendering in both orientations.

candidates.title: Invalid autocomplete value on personal data field
candidates.failure: An email field collecting the user's own address has autocomplete="mail" (not a valid token).
candidates.detectability_reason: axe autocomplete-valid checks token validity.

candidates.title: Missing autocomplete on personal data fields
candidates.failure: A form collecting the user's own name, email and postcode has no autocomplete attributes.
candidates.detectability_reason: Absence is detectable, but whether a field is about the user needs judgement.

candidates.title: Page regions not identified with landmarks
candidates.failure: A page with header, navigation, main content and footer built only from divs, with no landmarks, headings or skip link.
candidates.detectability_reason: Absence of landmarks is detectable; whether regions exist needs judgement.

candidates.title: Text over background image with insufficient contrast
candidates.failure: White text over a light area of a photo background with no overlay.
candidates.detectability_reason: Tools usually report background images as needing review.

candidates.title: Form field border has insufficient contrast
candidates.failure: Text inputs whose only visible boundary is a #dddddd border on white (1.4:1).
candidates.detectability_reason: Non-text contrast needs rendering; few rule engines check it.

candidates.title: Focus indicator has insufficient contrast
candidates.failure: A focus outline in light grey (#cccccc) on white.
candidates.detectability_reason: Needs focus-state rendering and comparison.

candidates.title: Informative icon has insufficient contrast
candidates.failure: An icon-only status indicator in #c0c0c0 on white.
candidates.detectability_reason: Contrast of graphics needs rendering and judgement of which parts are required.

candidates.title: Text sized only in viewport units
candidates.failure: Body text sized with font-size: 2vw so browser text zoom does not enlarge it.
candidates.detectability_reason: vw/vh font sizes are detectable in CSS; impact needs zoom testing.

candidates.title: Form controls do not resize with text
candidates.failure: Inputs with font-size set in px inside text set in em, so input text stays small when text is enlarged.
candidates.detectability_reason: Needs text-only zoom testing.

candidates.title: Text clipped when text spacing is increased
candidates.failure: A fixed-height box with overflow:hidden whose text is cut off when the text-spacing bookmarklet is applied.
candidates.detectability_reason: Needs applying the text-spacing override and checking for clipping.

candidates.title: Inline text spacing set with important
candidates.failure: Paragraphs with style="line-height: 1 !important; letter-spacing: 0 !important" that block user overrides.
candidates.detectability_reason: axe avoid-inline-spacing checks this.

candidates.title: Content lost when reflowed
candidates.failure: At 320 CSS px a media query hides part of the content (e.g. a table column) with no other way to reach it.
candidates.detectability_reason: Needs rendering at 320 px and comparing content.

candidates.title: Tooltip cannot be dismissed with Escape
candidates.failure: A focus- or hover-triggered tooltip that covers other content and only closes when focus or pointer moves away.
candidates.detectability_reason: Needs interaction with the tooltip.

candidates.title: Focus removed by script when received
candidates.failure: A link with onfocus="this.blur()" so it can never keep keyboard focus.
candidates.detectability_reason: blur-on-focus handlers are detectable by script analysis or interaction.

candidates.title: Drawing canvas with no keyboard alternative
candidates.failure: A freehand signature canvas that only accepts pointer input.
candidates.detectability_reason: Needs judging whether the function depends on path input.

candidates.title: Single character key shortcut cannot be turned off
candidates.failure: A script binds the "s" key (no modifier) to jump to search, with no way to disable or remap it.
candidates.detectability_reason: Needs key-press testing; static detection of key handlers is unreliable.

candidates.title: Positive tabindex scrambles form focus order
candidates.failure: A form whose fields have tabindex values that move focus out of reading order (e.g. postcode before name).
candidates.detectability_reason: Positive tabindex is detectable; whether order breaks meaning needs judgement.

candidates.title: Sticky footer hides focused element
candidates.failure: A fixed cookie banner covers the bottom of the viewport so focused links scroll underneath it entirely.
candidates.detectability_reason: Needs focus traversal with geometry checks.

candidates.title: Sticky header partly hides focused element
candidates.failure: A fixed header partially overlaps links as they receive focus.
candidates.detectability_reason: Needs focus traversal with geometry checks.

candidates.title: Page refreshes automatically with meta refresh
candidates.failure: A <meta http-equiv="refresh" content="30"> reloads the page with no way to turn it off.
candidates.detectability_reason: meta refresh is detectable in markup (axe meta-refresh).

candidates.title: Timed meta redirect
candidates.failure: A <meta http-equiv="refresh" content="10; url=..."> redirects after a delay.
candidates.detectability_reason: Detectable in markup.

candidates.title: Auto-rotating carousel without pause
candidates.failure: A carousel that advances every 3 seconds indefinitely with no pause, stop or hide control.
candidates.detectability_reason: Movement can be observed over time; controls need judgement.

candidates.title: Content updates interrupt the user
candidates.failure: A news ticker region with aria-live="assertive" that announces an update every 10 seconds with no way to postpone.
candidates.detectability_reason: Needs observing updates over time.

candidates.title: Session timeout loses entered data
candidates.failure: A form that "expires" after a short simulated session timeout and discards entered data on re-authentication, with no warning of the timeout.
candidates.detectability_reason: Needs waiting for the timeout and checking data retention.

candidates.title: Animation triggered by scrolling ignores reduced motion
candidates.failure: Parallax/scroll-triggered motion that runs even when prefers-reduced-motion is set, with no way to disable it.
candidates.detectability_reason: Can emulate prefers-reduced-motion and observe motion; non-essential judgement is manual.

candidates.title: Headings do not describe their section
candidates.failure: Headings such as "Section 1" and "More" above content they do not describe.
candidates.detectability_reason: Descriptiveness needs human judgement.

candidates.title: Labels do not describe the field purpose
candidates.failure: Inputs labelled "Field 1" and "Field 2" for name and email.
candidates.detectability_reason: Descriptiveness needs human judgement.

candidates.title: Long document without section headings
candidates.failure: A long article with clearly separate topics shown only as bold paragraphs or not marked at all.
candidates.detectability_reason: Needs judging that sections exist.

candidates.title: Repeated navigation block cannot be bypassed
candidates.failure: A page beginning with 40 navigation links before the main content, with no skip link, landmarks or headings.
candidates.detectability_reason: Tools check for skip links/landmarks/headings; whether blocks repeat needs a site.

candidates.title: Only one way to find pages in a set
candidates.failure: A small multi-page fixture where pages are reachable only through a linear "next" chain, with no menu, search or site map.
candidates.detectability_reason: Needs a set of pages and judgement.

candidates.title: No indication of location within a set of pages
candidates.failure: A multi-page fixture with no breadcrumb, current-page indication or descriptive titles.
candidates.detectability_reason: Needs a set of pages and judgement.

candidates.title: Navigation order differs between pages
candidates.failure: Two or more pages that repeat the same navigation links in a different order.
candidates.detectability_reason: A crawler can compare repeated navigation blocks across pages.

candidates.title: Same function labelled differently on different pages
candidates.failure: A search button labelled "Search" on one page and "Find" on another.
candidates.detectability_reason: A crawler can compare repeated components across pages; equivalence needs judgement.

candidates.title: Help link in inconsistent place across pages
candidates.failure: A "Contact us" help link that is in the header on one page and in the footer on another.
candidates.detectability_reason: Cross-page comparison of help mechanisms; identifying help needs judgement.

candidates.title: Path gesture required without single pointer alternative
candidates.failure: A slider or carousel that only responds to swipe gestures, with no buttons.
candidates.detectability_reason: Needs gesture testing.

candidates.title: Action triggered on pointer down
candidates.failure: A "Delete" button that acts on mousedown/pointerdown with no way to abort.
candidates.detectability_reason: down-event handlers are detectable in script; abort/undo needs judgement.

candidates.title: Shake to undo without alternative
candidates.failure: A devicemotion handler that clears a form when the device is shaken, with no UI alternative or way to disable it.
candidates.detectability_reason: Needs device-motion emulation.

candidates.title: Touch only interaction
candidates.failure: A control that listens only to touchstart/touchend, ignoring mouse and keyboard.
candidates.detectability_reason: Touch-only handlers are detectable in script analysis.

candidates.title: Drag and drop without single pointer alternative
candidates.failure: A sortable list reorderable only by dragging items.
candidates.detectability_reason: Needs judging alternatives to dragging.

candidates.title: Jargon used without definition
candidates.failure: Specialised terms (e.g. "subrogation", "indemnity") used with no glossary or inline definition.
candidates.detectability_reason: Needs judging which words are unusual.

candidates.title: Ambiguous word without pronunciation
candidates.failure: A sentence whose meaning depends on how a heteronym is pronounced (e.g. "read" or a name), with no pronunciation given.
candidates.detectability_reason: Needs language understanding.

candidates.title: Focus on field opens new window
candidates.failure: Focusing a date input opens a pop-up window (window.open in onfocus).
candidates.detectability_reason: Can be found by tabbing and observing new windows.

candidates.title: Selecting a radio button opens a new window
candidates.failure: Choosing a radio option immediately opens a new window with no prior warning.
candidates.detectability_reason: Observable by interaction; intent needs judgement.

candidates.title: Form submits automatically when last field is filled
candidates.failure: A four-digit code form that submits as soon as the last digit is typed, with no warning.
candidates.detectability_reason: Observable by interaction.

candidates.title: Financial submission without review or undo
candidates.failure: A payment form that commits a transfer on submit with no review step, confirmation or way to reverse it.
candidates.detectability_reason: Needs judging the transaction type and flow.

candidates.title: No context-sensitive help for complex field
candidates.failure: A tax reference field with an unexplained format and no hint or help link.
candidates.detectability_reason: Needs judging whether help is needed.

candidates.title: Data submission without confirmation
candidates.failure: A general contact form that submits irreversibly with no review or confirmation.
candidates.detectability_reason: Needs judging the flow.

candidates.title: Previously entered information requested again
candidates.failure: A two-step form that asks for the delivery address in step 1 and again for billing in step 2 with no "same as" option or pre-fill.
candidates.detectability_reason: Needs a multi-step flow and judgement.

candidates.title: Status message not announced
candidates.failure: "3 results found" or "Added to basket" text is inserted after an action without role="status" or a live region.
candidates.detectability_reason: Needs observing DOM updates and checking roles.

candidates.title: Custom checkbox without checked state
candidates.failure: A div styled as a checkbox with role="checkbox" but no aria-checked, toggled by script.
candidates.detectability_reason: Missing required ARIA state is detectable; state updates need interaction.

candidates.title: Focusable element inside aria-hidden
candidates.failure: A link inside a container with aria-hidden="true" that still receives keyboard focus.
candidates.detectability_reason: axe aria-hidden-focus detects this.

candidates.title: Disclosure button without expanded state
candidates.failure: A "Show more" button that reveals content but never sets aria-expanded.
candidates.detectability_reason: Needs interaction to see the state change is missing.

candidates.title: Paste blocked in password field
candidates.failure: A login form whose password field cancels paste events, blocking password managers.
candidates.detectability_reason: Paste handlers can be detected and tested by script.

candidates.title: Login requires transcribing a code without paste
candidates.failure: A one-time code split across six inputs that blocks paste and autofill.
candidates.detectability_reason: Paste/autocomplete behaviour is testable by script.

candidates.title: Object recognition CAPTCHA as only option
candidates.failure: A login step that requires selecting all images with traffic lights, with no other method.
candidates.detectability_reason: Needs judging the cognitive function test and alternatives (passes 3.3.8 via exception).

candidates.title: Link context only in unrelated content
candidates.failure: A "More" link whose purpose is explained only in a sidebar paragraph not programmatically associated with it.
candidates.detectability_reason: Needs judging programmatic context.
